name: DisequalityDispersion.agree_of_cutKey_eq
typeText:
∀ {V F A : Type} {arity : F → Nat} (K : Finset.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Term V F arity)) (x y : V)
  (I : DisequalityDispersion.Interpretation F arity A) (a a' : V → A),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.cutKey K x y I a) (DisequalityDispersion.cutKey K x y I a') →
    ∀ (u : DisequalityDispersion.Term V F arity),
      Membership.mem.{0, 0} K u →
        Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Term.eval I a u) (DisequalityDispersion.Term.eval I a' u)

source.code:
theorem agree_of_cutKey_eq (K : Finset (Term V F arity)) (x y : V) (I : Interpretation F arity A)
    (a a' : V → A) (h : cutKey K x y I a = cutKey K x y I a') :
    ∀ u ∈ K, u.eval I a = u.eval I a' := by
  intro u hu
  have h1 : a x = a' x := congrArg (fun c => c.1.1) h
  have h2 : a y = a' y := congrArg (fun c => c.1.2) h
  have h3 : ∀ u' : {u // u ∈ cutRest K x y}, u'.1.eval I a = u'.1.eval I a' :=
    fun u' => congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd h) u'
  by_cases hux : u = .var x
  · subst hux; exact h1
  · by_cases huy : u = .var y
    · subst huy; exact h2
    · have hmem : u ∈ cutRest K x y := by
        unfold cutRest
        exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨huy, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hux, hu⟩⟩
      exact h3 ⟨u, hmem⟩
